name: B10-0326/2025 (The Left) – Tackling China’s critical raw materials export restrictions
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on tackling China’s critical raw materials export restrictions
part_text:
This is a non-binding resolution from the Left group. It does not change any law. It calls on the EU to ease trade tensions with China over rare earth metals, which are vital for green technology. It asks the EU to cut its own raw material use by at least 10% by 2030, recycle more, and write fairer trade deals that help poorer countries process their own minerals instead of just exporting them.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a set of political demands, not legislation.
- **Who it affects:** EU trade policy, mining partnerships with poorer countries, and recycling rules.
- **What happens next:** The European Parliament votes on the text. If passed, it is sent to the Council and Commission, who are not obliged to act.
